2228-4279-4446.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2228-4279-4446.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2228-4279-4446.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

1580-2324-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1580-2324-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Proper Burial and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

620-1429-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2946-4871-5686-6248.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5686-6248.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2908-3536-3682-5542.easyPrerequisites: Cheering Fanatic does not have summoning sickness.
2908-3536-3682-5542.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker.
When Cheering Fanatic attacks, it triggers, allowing you to choose "Dreamstalker" and cause spells with that name to cost {1} less this turn.
During your main phase, cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying one mana.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Dream Stalker from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 3.

4316-5078-5231-7028.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

997-1003-4053-6989.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

3532-3949-5078-6259.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3949-5078-6259.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat.

2034-3234-3293-5414.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2034-3234-3293-5414.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Repeat
2034-3234-3293-5414.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

632-2034-3621-4927-5129.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-2034-3621-4927-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

2187-3941-4067-6281.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Possessed Skaab.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Possessed Skaab that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Possessed Skaab token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Possessed Skaab from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat.

2034-3263-4853-4888.description:
Activate Puppet's Conjurer by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a 0/1 Homunculus artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Homunculus, adding {C}{C}.
When the Homunculus dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Puppet's Conjurer.
Repeat.

2525-4681-5256.description:
Cast Body Double by paying {4}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Body Double.
Resolve the Body Double trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Body Double.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 2.

527-1909-4486.notablePrerequisites: Selvala does not have summoning sickness. You control a creature with power 3 or greater who has at least a +2/+0 boost from secondary effects.
527-1909-4486.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Selvala.
Repeat.
527-1909-4486.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

367-5712.notablePrerequisites:
Sorin has at least three loyalty counters on it.
An opponent cannot block Ezio.
Ezio does not have summoning sickness.
367-5712.description:
Activate Sorin's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing an opponent's life total to become 10.
Deal combat damage to that opponent using Ezio.
Ezio triggers, causing you to pay {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} to have that opponent lose the game.

1762-2144-3615-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
1762-2144-3615-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Wilhelt.
When Wilhelt dies, Myrkul triggers, exiling Wilhelt from your graveyard and creating a token copy of Wilhelt that is an enchantment.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Wilhelt's power.
Cast Humility by paying {2}{W}{W}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, the Wilhelt token triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token with decayed, which becomes a 1/1 Zombie without decayed due to Humility.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Zombie's power.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-1849-3000-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

718-803-4508-5184.description:
Activate Kumano by paying {1}{R}, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

2034-2775-2919-3192.notablePrerequisites: Ulasht has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-2775-2919-3192.description:
Activate Ulasht by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Slimefoot, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

622-712-2757.description:
Pay {1}{G} to Kamahl, targeting the basic land.
Tap the basic land with Earthcraft, untapping itself.
Wake Thrasher triggers getting +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1719-3078-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
1719-3078-3525.description:
Activate Soldevi Excavations by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Soldevi Excavations.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat any number of times.
